text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Ethereum's 2.9% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 1.8%, suggesting some rotation away from altcoins into the larger cap. The Fear & Greed Index at 31 reflects underlying caution, though its 6-point weekly gain indicates sentiment is stabilizing rather than deteriorating further. Bitcoin dominance holding steady above 56% and total volume at $60B show the market is functioning with reasonable liquidity despite the downward pressure.
